title: Winter Wonderland
kdp_subtitle: Snowy Animals, Snowmen and Winter Fun to Color, with Mazes, Counting and Dot-to-Dot for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: Penguins, snowmen and forest friends are playing
in the snow. Add your colors to every page!
description:
Bundle up for a snowy day of coloring!

Winter Wonderland is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Penguins, snowmen, owls, foxes and bunnies having fun in the snow
  • Snowflakes, pine trees and cozy little houses
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
A great winter break activity, snow-day boredom buster and holiday gift.
